collection.title: Collection management
collection.description: A professional catalog for slot cars (Scalextric, Ninco, Avant Slot, Scaleauto and more): images, purchase data, setup and documentation ready to share.
bullets: Photos from 6 views (front, sides, rear, top, chassis, 3/4)
Technical specs with components (motor, pinion, crown, guide, axles…)
Modification log with cost and history
Export a complete technical sheet to PDF
Advanced filters, grid/table view and CSV export
Digital, Museum and Workshop badges

inventory.title: Parts inventory
inventory.description: Parts and consumables with the same care as your collection: stock, prices and traceability down to the car you fit them on.
bullets: Categories, units, purchase price, dates and notes per item
Minimum stock, alerts and restocking when it is time to reorder
Filters by category, search and low-stock parts
Fit parts to cars from inventory (stock is deducted automatically)
Movement history and links to car modifications
Type-specific fields (material, gearing, and more)

timing.title: Timing and performance
timing.description: See how each car and each setup change performs with granular data and clear comparisons.
bullets: Lap times with millisecond precision
Session analysis: progress, histogram and delta vs best lap
Side-by-side comparison of two sessions
Setup analysis: compare setups across sessions
Performance comparison by lane
Charts for lap-time and speed progress

competitions.title: Competition system
competitions.description: Run events with the same rigour you apply in the garage: categories, rules and traceable results.
bullets: Competitions with circuits and categories
Public entries via a shareable link
Custom scoring rules and templates
Round times with penalties
Live ranking and presentation mode (Live TV)
CSV and PDF results export

analytics.title: Dashboard and analytics
analytics.description: A panel that summarises investment, fleet mix and performance so you can decide with data.
bullets: Collection metrics: cars, spend and trends
Charts by brand, type, shop and modifications
Investment over time
Top cars by cost and most-used components
